title: Finite scalar presentation preserves the K-flat scalar counit
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l, a scheme W, n≥0, and a flat-term K-flat complex P of completed ordinary modules on W. Let π be the actual projection from the completed ring sheaf to its exponent n+1 quotient. Let α:pbcExtend(π)≅scalarReductionExtension(W,n) be left-adjoint uniqueness for their common restriction functor. Then finiteReductionIso(W,n).hom_(QP) followed by coefficientFiniteReductionModel(W,P,n).hom equals pbcComplexCounit(π,P) followed by Q of the degreewise map α.hom_P. All maps are the specified canonical maps, and the equality is valid for zero complexes and n=0.

source.place: The scalar/pullback comparison on a flat-term K-flat representative in the finite-evaluation argument; Stacks Tags 07A6, 06YY and 0D6E.

proof.text: Construct the ordinary scalar presentation by left-adjoint uniqueness for exactly the same restriction functor. Its degreewise transpose is the ordinary scalar unit. Transpose the proposed counit equation through the pbc derived scalar adjunction. Uniqueness transfers the first transpose to the finite scalar adjunction. Its K-flat unit normalization, expressed in cochain quotient coordinates by CompletionUnit.finiteModel_unit, equals the localized ordinary unit. scalarComplexTranspose and the ordinary uniqueness equation give the same expression for the other side. Cancel the exact restriction comparison and apply injectivity of the Hom equivalence.

theorem finiteScalarReductionCounitNormalization (W : Scheme.{u}) (n : ℕ)
    (P : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E W).FullSubcategory) :
    let := sfExtensionAdditive l E W n
    (PurCompactSupport.finiteReductionIso l E W n).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj) ≫
        (coefficientFiniteReductionModel.{u, u} l E W P.obj P.property.1 n).hom =
      pbcComplexCounit
          (PurCompactSupport.projection l E (n + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 n) W) P.obj ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map
          ((NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex (finiteScalarOrdinaryReductionIso l E W n).hom
            (.up ℤ)).app P.obj)
